CHROMIUM: drm/i915: Fix divide-by-zero Oops i915 readout doesn't fill all of the various state out and assumes that the first atomic commit it receives is going to be a modeset. In some cases (for R67, it's all cases) Chrome will send a non-modeset commit to the kernel. When the non-modeset commit is received, intel_state is not filled in and has intel_state->active_crtcs == 0. Since readout has determined one crtc is active, we try to calculate the watermark which involves dividing by the number of active crtcs. Since intel_state->active_crtcs == 0, we Oops. This patch fixes exactly that scenario and assumes the rest of the driver will cope with the inconsistent state until we get a modeset. I've got a more general fix for this upstream, but it is much more invasive and given the drift between 3.18 and 4.19, is not guaranteed to work as well here as it does upstream.
